# I Brand Identity

> > I Brand Identity: AI-powered luxury brand strategy and transformation for travel, hospitality, and Web3 fintech brands using The Alchemy Foundation and Transmutation Method.

Founded by Martina Boshra, a neurodivergent brand strategist, I Brand Identity specializes in premium positioning, brand psychology, and conversion optimization for elite brands. The agency offers proprietary methodologies including The Brand Growth Alchemy, Brand Positioning MRI, and Premium Pricing Alchemist tools to help luxury businesses achieve measurable ROI through strategic brand transformation.
